Finding: The intended broey.net production domain is not serving the site, while application URLs use broey.com, which redirects to a domain-sale page.
Evidence: 2026-08-05 DNS/HTTP checks: broey.net unresolved; www.broey.net NXDOMAIN; broey.com resolved and returned 302 to https://www.atom.com/name/Broey. Built canonical, robots, sitemap, JSON-LD, and share URLs used https://broey.com.
Recommendation: Confirm domain ownership; attach apex/www to Vercel; configure DNS/TLS/canonical redirect; update all origin fallbacks and Vercel NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL; redeploy and verify public metadata.

Finding: The deployed dependency tree contains high-severity Next.js/PostCSS advisories.
Evidence: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=low exited 1 with 2 high vulnerabilities; npm suggested a breaking Next 16.3.0 path.
Recommendation: Choose a supported patched framework path in an isolated change and rerun lint, type check, build, route, browser, accessibility, and Lighthouse validation.

Finding: Public forms do not have a complete abuse-control strategy.
Evidence: Contact has honeypot and optional Turnstile, but both local Turnstile variables were absent; newsletter has honeypot only; neither API implements rate limiting.
Recommendation: Configure matched Turnstile/equivalent controls and add server/edge throttling with documented quota and failure behavior.

Finding: The site collects personal contact/newsletter data without a public privacy notice or policy link.
Evidence: No privacy or terms route/link was discovered; forms send data to Resend and MailerLite.
Recommendation: Publish owner/legal-approved disclosure covering purpose, providers, retention/contact, consent, and unsubscribe rights; link it in the footer and at collection points.

Finding: The contact email-updates checkbox does not subscribe the visitor.
Evidence: The UI offers updates, but the API only copies updatesOptIn into the Resend message and never calls MailerLite.
Recommendation: Implement explicit consented MailerLite subscription with correct status handling and records, or remove the checkbox/promise.

Finding: A public, indexable Watch route exposes unfinished placeholder/status content.
Evidence: HTTP 200 and canonical metadata; visible text includes Video archive coming soon, Coming soon, Queued, and In progress; route is hidden from nav/sitemap but not noindex.
Recommendation: For the smallest V1, return not found or noindex/restrict the route until final videos and copy are approved.

Finding: LiNK is highlighted/indexed while copy says its public platform links are pending verification.
Evidence: LiNK appears in the home carousel and sitemap; only local radio edit/Disco access is available and several fields explicitly say pending.
Recommendation: Verify and publish intended public destinations and final copy, or remove LiNK from highlighted/indexable V1 surfaces.

Finding: Paradise is indexable/in the sitemap with placeholder artwork and no local cover/audio.
Evidence: Route returned 200; coverAlt says Paradise artwork pending. External streaming links were reachable, but visible metadata/content communicates incompleteness.
Recommendation: Add approved artwork/content or temporarily exclude/noindex the page for V1.

Finding: SITE_VISIBILITY documentation and runtime behavior disagree.
Evidence: README says private enables gate/noindex/empty sitemap, but helper returns public/false constants and local SITE_VISIBILITY=private had no effect; /gate redirected to /.
Recommendation: Restore environment-aware visibility behavior and verify Production public plus Preview private/noindex policies.

Finding: Project-track indexability is inconsistent with sitemap policy.
Evidence: Twenty-two generated routes return 200 and are internally linked/indexable, but are omitted from the 23-URL sitemap; a content indexing field is not applied consistently.
Recommendation: Decide index versus noindex for project tracks and drive metadata, sitemap, and internal linking from one explicit policy.

Finding: Mobile-menu keyboard and focus behavior is incomplete.
Evidence: Browser test: menu opened and aria-expanded changed, but Escape left it open; source review found no focus capture/return or outside-dismiss handling.
Recommendation: Add Escape handling, initial/focus containment as appropriate, trigger focus return, and test keyboard/screen-reader behavior.

Finding: Several interactive targets are shorter than the recommended 44 CSS px.
Evidence: Measured examples: menu button about 36 px high; release Open link about 25 px high; additional press/footer targets were short though often wide.
Recommendation: Increase hit areas while preserving the visual design and retest mobile spacing/overlap.

Finding: The repository has no automated tests, format script, or CI workflow.
Evidence: npm test and npm run format both exited 1 with Missing script; no GitHub Actions workflows were found.
Recommendation: Add focused unit/integration/browser tests and CI that runs lint, strict type check, tests, and production build.

Finding: Repository-defined production security headers are absent.
Evidence: Local responses lacked CSP, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and X-Content-Type-Options and exposed X-Powered-By: Next.js; no headers() configuration was found.
Recommendation: Define a production-appropriate CSP/header policy, disable powered-by disclosure, and verify final Vercel responses without breaking embeds/media.

Finding: The full development dependency tree contains additional high advisories.
Evidence: npm audit --audit-level=low exited 1 with 8 high vulnerabilities total, including xlsx with no npm fix.
Recommendation: Remove/replace unused vulnerable tooling, isolate local-only scripts, or document accepted containment; keep production audit separate.

Finding: Shopify Storefront API version falls forward instead of honoring the requested pinned version.
Evidence: Code requests 2025-01; successful response reported 2025-10. Catalog returned six products, but compatibility is relying on Shopify fall-forward behavior.
Recommendation: Move to a currently supported pinned API version and regression-test product parsing, fallback behavior, and checkout links.

Finding: Large source/social assets and a lazy home LCP candidate add avoidable transfer risk.
Evidence: Public assets total about 322.6 MB; some art is 3-3.8 MB at 3000-4320 px. Lighthouse flagged the home LCP image as lazy; mobile LCP was 2.4 s.
Recommendation: Optimize oversized art/social files, retain suitable resolution/quality, and mark only the initially visible LCP image for priority loading.

Finding: Production cache behavior for large static media is unverified and local caching is conservative.
Evidence: Audio byte-range test returned 206/Accept-Ranges, but local static media returned Cache-Control: max-age=0.
Recommendation: Verify Vercel immutable/CDN caching for versioned media; add safe cache rules or fingerprinting and retest range/seek behavior.

Finding: Missing/error/loading recovery uses framework defaults or is absent.
Evidence: Unknown path correctly returned HTTP 404 and noindex, but only default Next UI was available and no route error/loading boundaries were found.
Recommendation: Add concise brand-consistent not-found and relevant error/loading recovery, especially around external merch/content data.

Finding: A merch item says Crewbeck, likely a credibility-affecting typo for Crewneck.
Evidence: Visible fallback title, Shopify URL slug, and image alt all contain Crewbeck while category/description say Crewneck.
Recommendation: Confirm official product naming, then correct Shopify source data and local fallback/alt text together.

File: No analytics or monitoring integration found
Finding: There is no production analytics, real-user performance telemetry, or error monitoring.
Evidence: Repository search and runtime inspection found no analytics/tracking/error-monitoring integration.
Recommendation: Add privacy-appropriate error/availability monitoring early; add analytics only after privacy/cookie review and owner decision.

Finding: Several legacy components appear unreferenced; one missing referenced WAV belongs to unused Hero.
Evidence: Manual import/reference scan found Hero, FeaturedRelease, HomepageMerchSection, HomepageConnectSection, AboutPreview, StayConnected, MerchPreview, BroeyAudioPlayer, and ActionLinkGrid only self-referenced. Knip was unavailable.
Recommendation: Confirm with installed dead-code tooling, then remove, archive, or document intentionally retained components/assets.

Finding: Sitemap lastModified values represent request time rather than content modification time.
Evidence: The sitemap generates current timestamps, making every URL appear newly modified on every request.
Recommendation: Use explicit content/release modification dates and stable timestamps.

Finding: Runtime/build context policy is under-specified.
Evidence: No package engines/runtime pin exists; reports/scripts/data remain in Vercel source upload; deprecated output tracing config warns during checks.
Recommendation: Pin a supported Node version, remove deprecated config, and reduce build context after confirming scripts/data are not required.

Finding: Services and Studio routes/sections do not exist.
Evidence: No current header/footer/navigation or core copy promises these surfaces, so their absence is not a broken V1 journey.
Recommendation: Keep deferred until the offering and content are approved; do not add placeholder navigation.

Finding: Owner-controlled write flows were not executed end to end.
Evidence: Read-only checks: MailerLite group 200, verified Resend sender domain 200, Shopify catalog 200/six products. No email, subscriber, purchase, or checkout record was intentionally created.
Recommendation: Run controlled production contact/newsletter submissions and cart-to-checkout smoke; inspect UI, provider records/logs, consent, reply-to, and fallback/error states.
External Dependency: Owner/provider accounts and intentional test records

Finding: Vercel Production variables, alias, runtime, DNS ownership, and final response/CDN configuration were not independently inspected.
Evidence: Local Vercel project link exists and local production build passes, but no owner account configuration was changed or read through an authenticated connector.
Recommendation: Confirm project/team, Production/Preview variable scopes, Node/runtime/region, domain aliases, DNS/TLS, headers, cache policy, and logs in Vercel.
